hero.title: Support Bitcoin Education

why_donations_matter.heading: Why Donations Matter
why_donations_matter.intro: Many Bitcoin projects survive on donations. Your support helps us:

points.education: Provide free, high-quality Bitcoin education to students across Africa
points.rewards: Reward students with sats for completing assignments and projects
points.infrastructure: Maintain infrastructure and tools for teaching
points.reach: Expand our reach to more countries and communities

payment_methods.heading: Bitcoin-Only Support
payment_methods.intro: We accept Bitcoin payments via Lightning Network and on-chain. Choose your preferred method:

onchain.title: On-Chain Address
onchain.label: Bitcoin Address
onchain.note_text: On-chain transactions may take longer to confirm and have higher fees.

transparency.heading: Transparency Plan
transparency.intro: We believe in transparency and accountability. Here's how we handle donations:

points.public_reporting_desc: Monthly reports on how donations are used
points.student_rewards_desc: Donations go directly to student sats rewards
points.infrastructure_desc: For tools, hosting, and educational resources
points.growth_desc: For expanding to new regions and communities

transparency.dashboard_note_suffix: for real-time metrics and detailed reports.

thank_you.heading: Thank You
thank_you.message: Your support helps build Bitcoin sovereignty and education in Africa. Every contribution, no matter how small, makes a difference.
